summary.text: Didi Barrett is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 106 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Barrett earned a B.A. in speech communication from the University of California, Los Angeles, and an M.A. in folk art studies from New York University.

Her professional experience includes creating the Dutchess Girls Collaborative and helping launch the North East Dutchess Fund of the Berkshire Taconic Community Foundation, on whose board she serves.
Barrett first served in Assembly District 103 from 2012 to 2013 and has represented District 106 since 2013, succeeding Ronald Canestrari.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as Agriculture, Energy (which she chairs), Environmental Conservation, and Tourism, Parks, Arts and Sports Development.
